name: Paper Shakespeare: Stick Merchant of Venice
source:
Shakespeare's classic play about how intolerance, bigotry, and revenge not only conspire to destroy society but also form deadly cycles of hate and abuse. NOW IN FAMILY FUN STICK DRAWING FORM.

Also, there's an Adventure Mode. Do you have the GUTS to REWRITE SHAKESPEARE? Instead of taking Shylock's money, maybe you just go off and FIGHT A CYCLOPS INSTEAD. Adventure Mode is only for the bravest of souls.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/852750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
莎士比亚经典戏剧讲述偏见、顽固与复仇如何共同摧毁社会，也如何形成仇恨与虐待的致命循环。如今，它以适合全家的火柴棍绘画形式呈现。

此外还有冒险模式。你有胆量重写莎士比亚吗？与其拿走夏洛克的钱，不如直接出发和独眼巨人战斗。冒险模式只属于最勇敢的灵魂。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/852750/]Steam[/url]]
